description: This file contains utility functions related to system properties and environment detection, specifically for identifying if the code is running in an emulator and for opening a modem port via system properties.

methods.name: strStartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a given line starts with a specified prefix.

methods.name: isInEmulator
methods.description: Determines if the current process is running inside an emulator VM.

methods.name: qemu_open_modem_port
methods.description: Attempts to open the modem port specified by a system property for QEMU emulators.
